title: Taskflow WAF
description: Coraza and Caddy telemetry for the Taskflow frontend and backend WAFs. The overview cards and activity chart come from Alloy metrics (all clients, Application filter only; their Client IP filtered versions are in a collapsed row). Rule breakdowns, top IPs and recent detections scan Loki and honor the Application and Client IP filters; pod and infrastructure metrics are service-level. RelevantOnly auditing emits no records for normal successful traffic.

panels.title: Overview — all clients; metrics since 2026-10-18 13:34 UTC; Client IP filter in collapsed row below
Detection-bearing audit records
panels.description: Coraza audit records containing rule matches in the selected range, from Alloy metrics (all clients, Application filter only). RelevantOnly auditing records only relevant transactions; normal traffic produces no audit records. Counts use a one-hour pre-window history guard to avoid replaying old totals after scrape gaps. Missing events cannot be reconstructed exactly; a gap beyond that guard can still count an old cumulative value as a first burst. Use Loki for investigation after outages.

targets.expr: (sum((increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application"}[1h] offset $__range)) or increase(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Confirmed interruptions (BLOCK)
panels.description: Detection records explicitly interrupted by Coraza (transaction.is_interrupted=true). From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter.

targets.expr: (sum((increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="true"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="true"}[1h] offset $__range)) or increase(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="true"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Detected without interruption
panels.description: Detection records where Coraza did not interrupt the request. Common for detect-only rules or non-disruptive phases. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter.

targets.expr: (sum((increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="false"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="false"}[1h] offset $__range)) or increase(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="false"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Interruption rate
panels.description: Percentage of detection records that were interrupted by Coraza. Guarded denominator; shows 'No detections' when undefined. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter.

targets.expr: (100 * (sum((increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="true"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="true"}[1h] offset $__range)) or increase(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="true"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])))) / (sum((increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application"}[1h] offset $__range)) or increase(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_detection_records_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])) > 0)) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: First-matched rule categories
panels.description: Detected audit records categorized by their first extracted CRS rule family. panels.description: Bytes per second Alloy gave up sending to Loki after its retries (or dropped at once after a 4xx answer). Failed pushes that are still being retried do not show here; see Logging pipeline for send errors, retries and Loki discards (for example line_too_long). Service-level metric: not affected by the Client IP filter.

options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **Coverage:** WAF metrics began on **2026-10-18 at 13:34 UTC**. Earlier events are available only in Loki. Metric counts use VictoriaMetrics `increase_pure()` to include each zero-origin counter's first burst; they cannot recover events before metrics began.
- **Filters:** Overview cards and the activity chart use metrics: **all clients**, Application filter only. Expand **Overview filtered by client IP (scans logs)** for IP-filtered summaries. Rule bars, tables and recent detections scan Loki and honor both filters. Pod/infrastructure panels are service-wide.
- **Zeros vs gaps:** Metric zeros require request-counter data and a successful Alloy scrape. Gaps can mean unavailable telemetry. A healthy scrape alone does not prove WAF logs are flowing. Empty rule panels mean no matching records in stored logs, not proof the pipeline is healthy.
- **RelevantOnly auditing:** Audit records can result from rule matches or response criteria. An audit record alone is not a detection; BLOCK requires `transaction.is_interrupted=true`.
- **Display limits:** Top tables are ranked top-10 subsets; recent logs show at most 100 records.
- **Redaction (Alloy, at ingestion):** Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie and Set-Cookie values; query values named like token, password, secret, code, state, session or api key (URI, Referer and Coraza messages); and Coraza matched data for cookies, Authorization headers, request bodies and credential-named arguments. Other matched data (for example `ARGS:q`) is the attack evidence and other headers and parameters are stored as sent. Coraza cuts matched data at 280 bytes; a fragment that long loses its "found within" part and is not recognised.
- **Line size:** Loki rejects a log line over 256 KB. Alloy drops the per-message `[uri ...]` copies from audit records, which keeps even a 20 KB padded URI far below that. A record that is still too large is lost in Loki (reason `line_too_long` in Logging pipeline) while the metric panels count it.
- **Other layers:** Cloudflare blocks and Cilium drops live on **Blocked Sources**.

panels.title: Raw WAF detection records
panels.description: Latest 100 detection-bearing audit records as stored in Loki, after ingestion redaction (credential headers, listed query parameters and the matched data of credential variables are replaced by REDACTED; other request and matched data are stored as sent, see Scope). No line_format or rule-description regexp is applied, so the complete stored JSON is available even when a summary field cannot be extracted.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "},\"messages\":[{" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | client_ip=~`$client_ip`
